Good Company, Poor Workmanship

The employees at River City Roofing have been helpful in dealing with my insurance claim but the roofers they hire are horrible. They took no measures to protect the gutters, siding, windows, A/C unit or plants and all were damaged. They installed permanently deformed/damaged shingles, left tar and other markings on every surface of the home, walkways and gutters and finished without performing any quality control checks or finishing cleanup. Although the nail line on the shingles is clearly marked, they left an excessive number of exposed nails and many more that will surely develop into leaks in the years to come. Lastly, our roof replacement cost 10% more than other reputable companies with the same products and warranties. Do not think you're getting better quality just because they cost more.

My Suggestions:
Hire your own inspector to inspect every inch of the roof, do a thorough walk-around to inspect your home for damage, take pictures of everything, do your own research and be familiar with the function and proper installation of all products (underlay, starter strip, shingles, etc.),

Purchasing the extended workmanship warranty is a MUST due to the lack of quality control.
